item.text: Periodontal risk assessment / clinical findings supporting scaling and root planing (probing depths, attachment loss, radiographic bone loss)

answer.valueString: Localized 4-5 mm pockets with bleeding on probing in the lower right and lower left posterior sextants; early attachment loss and early crestal bone changes. See PRA (DiagnosticReport/diagnosticreport-perio-risk-assessment).

item.text: Relevant systemic condition affecting periodontal risk (e.g., Type 1 diabetes)?

answer.valueString: Type 1 diabetes mellitus (E10.9), insulin-pump managed with CGM — materially elevates periodontal/infection/healing risk and drives the aggressive periodontitis pattern.

item.text: Medical-necessity justification for periodontal therapy in a pediatric patient

answer.valueString: Progression from plaque-induced gingivitis to localized slight aggressive periodontitis in a six-year-old within three months, accelerated by Type 1 diabetes. Non-surgical periodontal therapy (SRP) is indicated to arrest progression.
